\textbf{Posterior predictive check of the literature block.} For edges observed by a given number of literature annotators (x axis), the fraction with at least one literature report: observed (black) and the mean over 20 data sets replicated from each fitted estimator on the real observation masks (coloured; bars: mean $\pm 1.96$ replicate SD). Lower panels: observed divided by replicated (reference line at 1). Every estimator, including Family-HB, under-predicts the reporting rate of edges observed by many annotators and over-predicts it for edges observed by few (inference: observation is not ignorable).
